newsitem.title: JAPAN: One killed in coastal tanker fire off Yokohama.
newsitem.headline: One killed in coastal tanker fire off Yokohama.

text.p: A fire broke out on a coastal tanker off Yokohama on the Pacific coast early Monday and killed one of the seven people on board, a Maritime Safety Agency (MSA) official said.
The fire was first witnessed by one of the crew shortly after midnight on Monday and was put out by 4.45 a.m. (1945 GMT), the official said.
The 695 gross-registered-tonne tanker was not carrying any oil products at the time of the accident.

It was scheduled to ship 2,000 kilolitres of grade-A fuel oil from Nippon Oil Co Ltd's Negishi refinery in Yokohama to the oil firm's terminal in Nagoya in central Japan on Wednesday, a company spokesman said.
Nippon Oil has already made arrangements for another tanker to take the fuel oil supplies to Nagoya.
The cause of the fire is under investigation.
